name: City and County of San Francisco budget

adopted.basis: FY 2026-27 (year ending June 30, 2027), City and County of San Francisco Budget and Appropriation Ordinance as enacted (File 260596, Ordinance 140-26, enacted 7/30/2026). Consolidated Schedule of Sources and Uses: 'Sources of Funds Total' (equal to 'Uses of Funds Total'), all funds = General Fund + Self Supporting, net of $1,540,146,504 interdepartmental recoveries (gross expenditures before recoveries are $17,347,076,734). General Fund column includes $297,199,449 transfers in and $1,417,724,952 transfers out to other funds.

citations.locator: Consolidated Schedule of Sources and Uses, printed page 11 (PDF page 13 of 278), row 'Sources of Funds Total', FY 2026-27 columns General Fund and Total
